scope: Proposition 3.2 of the manuscript “Bounded anticanonical metrics on klt pairs and torus quotients” (preprints/Bounded-anticanonical-metrics-on-klt-pairs-and-torus-quotients-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2420934378c18da6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a positive rational number δ and a rational character shift of arbi- trarily small size for the ample rational linearized bundle L + δJ such that its stable locus U is nonempty and equals its semistable locus. Every x ∈ U satisfies (15) wL(x, λ) ≥ 0 for all integral one-parameter subgroups λ. The shift is used only to define U; the linearization on L remains natural.
